item.title: We would move out of Ocala tomorrow if we could afford it
item.description: "I agree 100% with Chip Brown, who moved here to leave South Florida. We moved here 9 years ago. We would move tomorrow if we could afford it. We are living in a 55+ community and our home value has dropped tremendously. The owner has raised the HOA so high. We need to move, but that is not going happen any time soon, I am sure.
